answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a small refundable stake that only unlocks after a long season of honest work — a ledge you climb once and then stand on. Peers then grade each other's work through a prism of independent checks, so one operator running a hundred sock-puppets cannot grade itself into profit. The onyx test is simple: if a record shows only self-dealing and no real counterparties, the stake stays locked and its votes count for nothing.
